# Howm use any markup
This package provides command howm-insert-prop-line, that inserts
prop-line file local variable of selected major mode into first line
of the file and than enables howm minor mode. It may gain more
functionality in the future.

In this repo I want to demonstrate how any markup can be used with
hitori-otegaru-wiki-modoki emacs minor mode and also create command
that will change emacs major mode in buffer and add file local
variables to set selected major mode automatically on the next
occurence of opening that file.
